english.note: Use this as the all-purpose formal noun for the abstract property of never being wrong, especially in academic or religious writing.

examples.english: The infallibility of this theory still needs to be verified by the academic community.
examples.traditional: 呢套理論嘅無謬性，仲有待學術界驗證。
